attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration of Allied Health Professions

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities relating to the science or contemporary clinical practice of physical therapy: continuing competence programs (1 point per contact hour or equivalent as awarded by the provider, up to 24); publications (up to 22 points per book, 2 per chapter or peer-reviewed article); teaching (academic course 4 points per credit, CE courses 1 point per contact hour; max 10 points, half value for repeats); academic coursework (1 point per credit, max 6); other APTA- or AOTA-approved activities (max 6). Board-recognized entities include APTA and FSBPT.
rules.new_licensee_rule: For PTs/PTAs licensed by examination the requirement starts after the first renewal period following initial licensure.
rules.audit_note: Signed statement under pains and penalties of perjury at renewal; the Board may randomly audit documentation for two prior renewal periods.

topics.who: 2 points in ethics, laws and regulations governing practice in Massachusetts each renewal period (within the 24)

rules.notes: The Board counts points: 1 point per contact hour for continuing competence programs. Licenses expire every two years on the licensee's birthday (259 CMR 2.00). Only activities completed in the 24 months before the renewal date count. Requirement in force since April 29, 2022; an older Board FAQ saying MA has no CE requirement is outdated.
